messages:
michael: FYI — we started seeing a spike in late EU events from 2026-03-19 22:10->23:30 UTC. It's causing aggregate counts to miss ~12h. I propose a staged replay to avoid saturating our ingest gateway. Need someone to own quotas and the console visibility for users.

sara: can you paste event ids / shards affected?

michael: most late events are from shard eu-3 and eu-7. sample ids: a1f3..., b4e9... Not many duplicates. I ran a quick check: `select count(*) from telemetry.ingest where day='2026-03-19' and shard in ('eu-3','eu-7')` — gap ~1.2M rows.

kevin: ok. my worry: running full replay at scale will hit the public API rate limits and our downstream aggregator gets overwhelmed. We should use the replay service with per-shard rate caps. I'll propose 300 rps per shard and 10 token-batches per request.

jia: +1 for per-shard caps. Also we should enable the "priority-lane" for telemetry backfills so it doesn't affect user traffic. That requires a console toggle — @product has that? :thinking_face: 

ops-bot: replay-job created: job_id=rb-20260319-1749. current status=PENDING. See https://internal.replay/jobs/rb-20260319-1749

kevin: updating job config: 
```
replay_job_id=rb-20260319-1749
shards=['eu-3','eu-7']
rate_per_shard=300
parallel_workers=4
dedupe_window=10m
```
I'll start with 15m canary at 50rps.

michael: can we ensure dashboards show a "replay load" dimension and annotate the customer-facing dashboards? Need to avoid ops paging on spike.

david: I'll add a graph to the telemetry console, metric key=telemetry.replay.ingest_rps and a boolean annotation when job starts. ETA 20m.

jia: also add a QoS route rule: route replay requests through dedicated replay-gateway cluster (replay-gw) so they don't count against public routing quotas. We have the proxy flag ready: `X-Replay-Gateway: replay-gw`.

sara: sequenced plan sounds good. who's owning rollback policy? If aggregator error rate > 1% we should auto-throttle or pause.

kevin: I'll wire in the auto-pause: monitor downstream 5xx ratio > 1% over 2m => scale down rate by 50% and notify #eng-oncall. If still >1% after 5m pause, job => PAUSED and owner notified.

michael: perfect. assign owner: @kevin takes replay ops. @david adds dashboard. @jia updates route. I'll document steps in the runbook after the canary.

sara: thanks. I'll join for canary watch. :thumbsup:
